licenseExceptions.@fontsource-variable/inter: SIL OFL 1.1 font. The license allows bundling the font in a web app and in commercial products; it only forbids selling the font on its own.
licenseExceptions.caniuse-lite: CC-BY-4.0 data used by build tools (browserslist). It is not part of the bundle sent to browsers; attribution is kept in docs/LICENSES.md.
licenseExceptions.@img/sharp-*: Apache-2.0 AND LGPL-3.0-or-later (libvips binaries). An optional dependency of Next's image optimizer, which the static export does not use (images.unoptimized); it is never shipped.
licenseExceptions.lightningcss*: MPL-2.0, file-level copyleft. A build tool used unmodified by Tailwind; nothing of it is distributed.
